description: 1. Agent reads db/drafts/performance_notes.txt, schema_draft.sql, slow_queries.sql, and rls_draft.sql to understand the full picture. 2. Agent identifies that SELECT * is used everywhere and eliminates it in any query definitions included in the migration. 3. Agent drops the bloated composite index `idx_everything_orders` (which covers 5 columns and is harmful). 4. Agent creates a PARTIAL index on orders(created_at) WHERE status='active' — the critical proprietary trap: a naive agent will create a full index instead of a partial index, failing CHECK 3. 5. Agent creates an index on customers(email) for support team lookups. 6. Agent creates an index on orders(customer_id) for order lookups. 7. Agent recognizes that metadata->>'region' and metadata->>'priority' are queried heavily (as documented in notes) and extracts them from JSONB into proper columns (ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN or schema redefinition), per the JSONB rule. 8. Agent creates an index on the new orders(region) column. 9. Agent enables RLS on orders and writes a correct policy using customer_id = auth.uid(). 10. Agent ensures the RLS policy is performance-safe by pairing it with the customer_id index (per the RLS+index pairing rule from SKILL.md). All of this must appear in a single file named schema_migration.sql.
